result.summary: Expands unit test coverage for BIP352 (Silent Payments) in `src/test/bip352_tests.cpp`. The new tests cover edge cases including invalid public keys across supported inputs, P2PKH extraction with unrelated script pushes, annex handling, Taproot script-path spends, control block validation, destination validation, and SegWit versions v2 through v16.
result.problem: Existing BIP352 unit tests leave numerous edge cases and error branches unverified, allowing potential regressions or implementation bugs in silent payments parsing and validation to slip through undetected.
evidence: PR description: 'Out of 55 mutations, 33 survived with the existing tests. With these tests, 52 of the 55 mutations are detected.'

PR description: 'Using bcore-mutation with --one-mutant and the bip352_tests test suite, the mutation score improves from 83.93% (9 of 56 mutations surviving on master) to ... 98.21% (1 of 56 surviving with this version).'
result.scope_notes: Modifies only `src/test/bip352_tests.cpp` without touching production code.
result.card: Adds unit tests to cover previously untested BIP352 (Silent Payments) edge cases and error paths in `src/test/bip352_tests.cpp`. Existing test vectors missed scenarios such as annex handling, invalid public keys across inputs, maximum-size control blocks, and SegWit versions v2 through v16. Mutation testing demonstrated 33 of 55 manual mutations survived existing tests on master, whereas this PR detects 52 (with the remaining three being functionally equivalent). It requires no prerequisites.

risk.why: Only touches unit test code; flawed tests could cause false CI failures or fail to catch BIP352 regressions.
